summary: Plus @jny who is to say the Galley itself will be around forever? At least journalist who owned their content from the outset would not have to worry about backing it up or archiving it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Plus @jny who is to say the Galley itself will be around forever?

At least journalist who owned their content from the outset would not have to worry about backing it up or archiving it.
